name: BACH_0328
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (93%)** · Confident · Careful review
Unflagged tier-4 biopsy [F1] (0% invasive risk, ER stain drafted), though models and neighbors disagree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 93%, Benign 5%, Normal 2%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%) | Zero invasive risk; small test set |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 10% alpha (90% coverage, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 55% reliability, 26% OOD, 10 regions kept [F6] (AUROC 70%) | Typical image; moderate reliability |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 20% (1/5 InSitu [F5]; 3 Normal, 1 Benign) | Poor neighbor agreement |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-2.05) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-1.34), against invasion [F3] (20/20 check) · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4) · context · Below-typical (-0.50) [F4]; descriptive (8/20 AI check) · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 1, 7, 10) · context · Zero neoplastic/epithelial nuclei; insufficient tumor nuclei flagged · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088–0.0064); uses unreliable normal lobules (0/20 AI check) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is non-neoplastic: 4/5 neighbors are Normal/Benign (BACH_0170 Normal, 87% similar, differs in unreliable mitoses/TILs).
- Atypia or invasion is missed where CONCH–MUSK disagree and HoVer-Net found zero tumor nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 7, 10**: Highest heatmap risk (5%, 1%, 1%), yet HoVer-Net counted zero neoplastic/epithelial nuclei.
2. **Regions 4, 8, 10**: Verify InSitu versus normal lobules (unreliable 0/20 concept) before confirming ER stain.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 8**: Check duct-confined atypia (region 8), invasion (region 4), and pleomorphism (region 1).
